content:
Amunbet Casino brings the gods of ancient Egypt to your screen, with a design full of gold, sand and hieroglyphs. Ra opens the week with a reload, Bastet hands out free spins on Wednesday, Seth rewards high rollers on Sunday and the VIP club climbs from Anubis to Amun-Ra. Behind the theme sits a full Amunbet Casino Online platform: thousands of slots, live dealer tables, crash games and a sportsbook, all in one account and all in pounds sterling.

New players start with a welcome package of 450% up to £2,700 and 450 free spins, spread over three deposits. Whether you know the brand as Amunbet or Amun Bet, it is the same casino, and this page shows how the bonuses, games, payments and account work for players in the UK. Everything is shown in GBP, from the bonus caps to the payment limits, so there is no need to convert amounts from euros before you decide how much to deposit.

450% Welcome Package

The welcome offer is the main reason most players open an account. You can choose between a standard package for regular budgets and a single high roller bonus for larger first deposits.

The standard Amunbet Casino Bonus is split into three steps, each with its own match and free spins:

The third step has the highest match, so it pays to plan your deposits rather than claim everything at once. A £100 first deposit, for example, adds £150 in bonus money and 100 free spins. Each Amunbet Bonus comes with its own wagering, maximum bet and expiry date, all shown in the bonus section of your account before you activate it. Bonus money and free spins are credited after the qualifying deposit, and only one bonus can be active at a time. If you request a withdrawal while wagering is still running, the remaining bonus is cancelled, so it is worth finishing one step before moving on to the next.

Highroller Bonus

Players who prefer one large deposit can pick the First Deposit Highroller Bonus instead: 250% up to £4,500 plus 250 free spins. It replaces the first step of the standard package, so decide which route suits your budget before you make the first payment. The Amun Bet Bonus for high rollers gives more money in one go, while the three-step package gives more free spins in total.

Get Started in Four Steps

Opening an account at Casino Amunbet takes only a few minutes:

  1. Click Sign up, enter your email address and create a strong password.

  2. Add your personal details exactly as they appear on your ID and confirm you are 18 or older.

  3. Verify your account. The Ankh Verification mission even rewards you with 25 CP for completing this step.

  4. Make your first Amunbet Deposit from £18 and activate the welcome bonus you prefer.

Tip: complete verification before your first withdrawal. It saves time later and unlocks missions that pay points for the Bonus Store.

Weekly Promotions

After the welcome package, there is an offer on almost every day of the week, and each one is named after an Egyptian god.

Reloads and Free Spins

Ra's Monday Reload gives 50% up to £500, Bastet's Wednesday Free Spins add up to 150 spins and the Golden Weekend Ladder pays up to £750 over Saturday and Sunday. High rollers can claim Seth's Highroller Sunday with 100% up to £1,000. On top of that, Daily Amunbet Free Spins hand out 50 spins, and the Wheel for Every Deposit gives an extra spin each time you top up your balance.

Missions and VIP Club

Missions such as Amun's Trio Quest and Amun's Triple Deposit pay CP points that you exchange in the Bonus Store for free spins and bonus money. The same points also move you through the Amunbet Loyalty Program. It has eight ranks named after Egyptian gods, starting at Anubis and ending at Amun-Ra, with daily cashback that grows with every rank and rakeback from the higher levels. Each new rank comes with a reward, from free spins at the start to bonus money at the top.

Games at Amunbet

The lobby is divided into clear categories such as Best Slots, Bonus Buy, Bonus Wagering, Crash Games and Top Games, so you can find a new favourite in a few clicks. Most slots also have a demo mode, so you can try a game's features and volatility before you play with real money. A search bar and provider filter make it easy to jump straight to a studio you already know.

Slots

Slots make up the largest part of the catalogue, from classic fruit machines to Megaways, Hold and Win and jackpot titles. The Bonus Wagering category is especially useful with an active bonus, because it lists the games that count fully towards wagering. Large tournaments add extra prizes on selected slots, with prize pools that regularly reach six figures. In most tournaments you collect points based on your stakes or your biggest multiplier, and a live leaderboard shows your position until the event ends. Weekly tournaments run all year round, while special races appear for a limited period with larger prize pools.

Live Casino

The Amunbet Live Casino covers roulette, blackjack, baccarat and game shows with real dealers, streamed around the clock. A daily cashback of 30% on live casino play returns part of your losses at the tables, which makes Amun Bet Casino one of the more generous options for live players. Tables run at different limits, so both casual players and high rollers can find a seat, and game shows add a lighter alternative to the classic card and wheel games. The cashback is calculated daily, so even a losing evening at the roulette wheel gives something back the next day.

Sports Betting

The sportsbook uses the same balance as the casino. You can bet on football, tennis, the NFL, boxing and many other markets, both before the start and live, without moving money between wallets.

Payments in GBP

Amunbet accepts bank transfer, Visa, Mastercard and ten cryptocurrencies, including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Tether, Solana and XRP. Deposits are instant and free of charge.

Instant

The fastest Amunbet Withdrawal is through crypto, which is processed instantly once your account is verified. Card payouts take one to three days, bank transfers up to a week. Use the same method for deposits and withdrawals where possible, and make sure every payment method is registered in your own name. Before the first payout, Amunbet Casino asks for proof of identity and address; uploading these documents straight after registration is the easiest way to avoid delays. Withdrawals are processed only from your real-money balance, so complete or cancel any active bonus before you request your winnings.

Amunbet Login and App

Returning to your account is quick. Click Sign in at the top of any page, enter your email and password, and the Amunbet Casino Login takes you straight to your balance, active bonuses and VIP progress. If you forget your password, use the reset link in the login window. The Amunbet Login works the same way on desktop and mobile.

There is no separate Amunbet App to download. The site is built for mobile browsers on iOS and Android, so you can play slots, join live tables, bet on sport and make payments directly from your phone. Add the page to your home screen for one-tap access.

Licence and Security

Amunbet protects personal and payment data with SSL encryption and checks your identity before withdrawals. The full rules on accounts, bonuses, payments and complaints are published in the Terms and Conditions and Bonus Terms, which are worth reading before your first deposit. Only one account per person is allowed, and bonuses are linked to that single verified account. If you have a question about your account, a bonus or a payment, the support team can help. Support itself is available through live chat on every page.

Play Responsibly

Gambling should always be entertainment, not a way to make money. Set deposit limits before you start, take regular breaks and use the self-exclusion option if play stops being fun. Keep track of how much time and money you spend, never chase losses and do not play when you are tired or upset. Free and confidential help in the UK is available from GamCare and BeGambleAware.
